frozen_scope.purpose: Value predictability ceiling on development data only.

split.cluster: LibriSpeech speaker id derived from the second component of source_key

target.value_source: full_adaptive_scores from the frozen prediction bundle

feature_ladder.posterior: short_scores from the frozen prediction bundle

X1.name: posterior_temporal_context
features: trailing mean of p in the current and previous 24 frames
trailing standard deviation of p in the current and previous 24 frames
trailing mean of abs(p_t - p_(t-1)) in the current and previous 24 frames
ordinary least squares slope of p over the current and previous 24 frames
X1.boundary_rule: Statistics reset at each contiguous source/noise/condition utterance variant.

X2.name: plus_short_hidden
features: all 128 channels of model.short_model.encoder(features) at the current frame

X3.name: plus_cheap_causal_acoustic_context
features: 64 causal MFCC coefficients at the current frame
trailing mean of each MFCC coefficient over the current and previous 24 frames
MFCC coefficient delta: current minus previous frame
X3.boundary_rule: Acoustic statistics reset at each contiguous source/noise/condition utterance variant.

logistic.scaler: StandardScaler fitted on calibration speakers only
logistic.prediction: expected signed value from predict_proba times fitted classes

mlp_ceiling_probe.input_scaler: StandardScaler fitted on calibration speakers only
mlp_ceiling_probe.loss: cross entropy with inverse-frequency class weights
mlp_ceiling_probe.prediction: expected signed value from softmax probabilities times class values
mlp_ceiling_probe.stopping_rule: fixed 30 epochs; no test-based early stopping

selection.rule: For each score and budget, select the highest-scoring calibration frames with ceil(budget * calibration_frames), take the minimum selected calibration score as the fixed threshold, and apply that threshold to test frames.
selection.oracle_reference: Test-only top-budget upper bound; never a deployable candidate.

metrics.oracle_value_recovery: sum(v * selected) / sum(max(v, 0)) over the evaluated test split
also_report: positive oracle sum and net selected value

bootstrap.paired_comparison: same resampled speaker clusters for both scores

decision_rules.uncertainty_near_observable_ceiling: No X1/X2/X3 model improves X0 oracle-value recovery by more than 0.01 with a paired speaker-cluster 95% CI lower bound above zero at any budget.
decision_rules.richer_features_add_observable_signal: At least two budgets have a paired speaker-cluster 95% CI lower bound above zero for oracle-value recovery improvement over X0, with a maximum mean improvement greater than 0.02.
decision_rules.large_irreducible_routing_gap: The best learned non-oracle oracle-value recovery is below 0.25 at both 1% and 2% budgets and below 0.50 at the 5% budget.
decision_rules.no_new_router_by_default: AX1 is diagnostic. A learned-router direction is only reconsidered if richer_features_add_observable_signal passes; otherwise preserve the frozen uncertainty router.
